symbolDescription: Props passed to `controlsComponent`. Position it yourself; the container is the positioning context.

optionDescriptions.rotateLeft: Rotates the globe one step to the left.
optionDescriptions.rotateRight: Rotates the globe one step to the right.
optionDescriptions.zoomIn: Moves the camera one step closer.
optionDescriptions.zoomOut: Moves the camera one step away.
optionDescriptions.reset: Returns the camera to the pose the globe opened on.
optionDescriptions.canZoomIn: False once the camera is at `minZoom`.
optionDescriptions.canZoomOut: False once the camera is at `maxZoom`.
optionDescriptions.canReset: False while the camera is already sitting at the home pose.
optionDescriptions.messages: The globe's resolved UI strings, for the buttons' accessible names.
